review.notes: Triage review. (a) Full structural scan: no code fences at all; the complete '#'-heading tree (Abstract, Contents, sections 1-7, References) matches the printed structure with no spurious headings, banner promotions or demoted headings. (b) Full-document droppage scan: normalized 4-gram containment for all 60 extracted PDF pages plus a line-level 8-gram missing-lines pass over every page with missing content (1, 10-15, 18, 20, 22, 24-27, 30, 32-34, 37, 38, 40, 45-47, 50, 53, 56, 58, 59); all misses resolved as LaTeX-math-equivalent rewrites, figure-internal demo prompts/waveform descriptions (pp.13, 27, 33-34, 40, 45-46 - the figures themselves are embedded incl. Figure 33's audio-comparison panel), chart axis/bar labels (pp.1, 24, 30) or reference-list accent decomposition artifacts in the extractor (md keeps the correct precomposed names). All 33 Figure captions and all Table captions are present; the contributor list (p.49) is complete at 61 names, with 'Wei Wang~1/2' an ASCII rendering of the printed 'Wei Wang~1/2' affiliation marks. Two page-bottom footnote bodies were dropped while their superscript markers survived - restored by the two patches. (c) Renders visually verified at 170 dpi: pp.38 and 40.
